steps.title: Build tens and ones

options.label: One ten and four ones make which number?
Ten counters are ready. Add six extra ones to make sixteen.
Two complete tens have no extra ones. What number is that?

steps.hint: Start with ten, then count on the four extra ones.
steps.explanation: Keep a whole ten together, then add the extra ones.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Build tens and ones
mathWorkshop.goal: Keep a whole ten together, then add the extra ones.

tasks.prompt: One ten and four ones make which number?
tasks.feedback: One whole ten and four extra ones make fourteen.
tasks.hint: Start with ten, then count on the four extra ones.

tasks.prompt: Ten counters are ready. Add six extra ones to make sixteen.
tasks.feedback: Sixteen is one ten and six ones. The ten stays a whole group.
tasks.hint: Keep the ten you started with. Count on six extra counters.

tasks.prompt: Two complete tens have no extra ones. What number is that?
tasks.feedback: Two tens make twenty; there are zero extra ones.
tasks.hint: Each full frame is ten. Count whole tens: ten, twenty.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Ten and ones
steps.prompt: What number do the ten and ones make?
steps.hint: Count the full ten, then count on the ones.

steps.title: More tens and ones
steps.prompt: What number do the ten and ones make?
steps.hint: Start at 10, then count on each loose one.

steps.title: Seventeen
steps.hint: The first digit counts tens; the second counts ones.
steps.explanation: The 1 is one ten; the 7 is seven ones.
steps.shortExplanation: The 1 is one ten; the 7 is seven ones.

steps.title: Twenty
steps.hint: How many full tens make 20? Are any ones left over?
steps.explanation: 20 has 2 tens and no extra ones.
steps.shortExplanation: 20 has 2 tens and no extra ones.

steps.title: Smallest first
steps.prompt: Put the numbers in order, smallest first.
steps.hint: Find the number with no tens first.
steps.explanation: Compare the tens first, then the ones.
steps.shortExplanation: Compare the tens first, then the ones.

steps.title: Counting in tens
steps.prompt: Count in tens and fill the gaps.
steps.hint: Each step adds one more ten.
steps.explanation: Counting in tens adds a whole ten each time.
steps.shortExplanation: Counting in tens adds a whole ten each time.

steps.title: Tens from 4
steps.prompt: Count on in tens: 4, 14, __, 34. What is missing?
steps.hint: Add a ten each time. The ones digit stays the same.
steps.explanation: Adding ten to 14 gives 24. The ones stay 4.
steps.shortExplanation: Adding ten to 14 gives 24. The ones stay 4.

steps.title: Writing sixteen
steps.prompt: Omar wrote sixteen as 61. Choose sixteen.
steps.hint: Sixteen is one ten and six ones. Which digit comes first?
steps.explanation: Sixteen is one ten and six ones: 16.
steps.shortExplanation: Sixteen is one ten and six ones: 16.

source.answerKeyText: No — 16. The ten is written first.

steps.title: Tens in 13
steps.hint: How many full tens fit in 13? How many are left?
steps.explanation: 13 is one full ten and three more ones.
steps.shortExplanation: 13 is one full ten and three more ones.

steps.title: Ten more
steps.explanation: Ten more than 5 is one ten and five ones: 15.
steps.shortExplanation: Ten more than 5 is one ten and five ones: 15.

steps.title: Tens pattern
steps.hint: Each number is ten more than the one before.

steps.title: In order
steps.prompt: Which is in order, smallest first?
steps.hint: Check that each number is bigger than the one before.
steps.explanation: 4, then 11, then 18: each number is bigger than the last.
steps.shortExplanation: 4, then 11, then 18: each number is bigger than the last.

steps.title: The 1 in 18
steps.prompt: Look at 18 as tens and ones. What does the 1 in 18 stand for?
steps.hint: In 18, the first digit counts tens.
steps.explanation: The 1 in 18 stands for one whole ten, the full ten frame.
steps.shortExplanation: The 1 in 18 stands for one whole ten, the full ten frame.

stickers.meaning: 16 is one ten and six ones.

homeActivities.text: Bundle ten safe large counters and add loose ones to build teen numbers. Make two bundles for 20 and practise counting whole tens.
homeActivities.textAr: اربطوا ١٠ حتت كبيرة وآمنة في حزمة واحدة، وزوّدوا حتت سايبة عشان تعملوا الأرقام من ١١ لـ ١٩. اعملوا حزمتين عشان ٢٠، واتمرّنوا تعدّوا بالعشرات.
